text:
With cálida aflicción, to the fin is deshizo the largo beso:

and as the últimas gotas repentinas caen

of the resplandeciente alero when the tormenta ha huido,

to solas vaciló the latir of his corazones.

His pechos is apartaron, with the brotar abierto

of the flores nupciales to his lado, extendidas

from the tallo unido, more still his bocas ardiendo

is acariciaron where yacían separadas.


The sopor the hundió more profundamente that the marea

of the sueños, and his sueños the vieron sumergirse

and escapar. Delicadas his almas flotaron of new

for esplendores acuáticos, and, ahogados, grises

objetos of the day; until that for a prodigio

of leños nuevos and corrientes él is despertó and more

is maravilló: for ella estaba to his lado.




“Nuptial Sleep”
